Ava (CS): @Kai FYI Ventrix asked for a short APAC pilot: add two CIDRs to allowlist and soft QPS bump to 350 for 6 days. Can infra & network confirm?
Kai (Ventrix): Pilot 2026-04-12..2026-04-17. CIDRs: 203.0.113.96/28 and 198.51.100.64/27. Want read-only dashboard for ops@ventrix.com.
Tom (Eng-Infra): OK. Need region pin preference and auto-revoke? Will set soft quota alert.
Rina (Network): Recommend pin to ap-southeast-1 (apac-east). Auto-revoke=6 days is fine. We'll tag ACLs with ventrix-pilot-0412 ttl=6d. Add fallback to apac-west if apac-east >75% util.
Tom (Eng-Infra): Draft config (account-scoped):
```json
{ "account":"ventrix", "edge_pool":"apac-east", "allowlist":["203.0.113.96/28","198.51.100.64/27"], "rate_limit":{"qps":350,"type":"soft"}, "meta":{"pilot":"2026-04-12..2026-04-17","auto_revoke_days":6} }
```
Tom (Eng-Infra): CLI for ops (ops-only):
```bash
redwood infra acl add --account ventrix --cidr 203.0.113.96/28 --tag ventrix-pilot-0412 --ttl 6d
redwood infra acl add --account ventrix --cidr 198.51.100.64/27 --tag ventrix-pilot-0412 --ttl 6d
redwood infra routing set --account ventrix --edge-pool apac-east --policy prefer
redwood infra rate update --account ventrix --qps 350 --type soft
```
deploy-bot: change job queued job-101210 by Tom; apply 2026-04-11T22:00:00Z.
Tom (Eng-Infra): I'll add capacity fallback to apac-west and a 10s KV warmup on reroute. Rollback: remove tags + revert routing if error rate >1% for 5m. I'll post telemetry at 24h and a short summary after pilot.
Kai (Ventrix): Thanks 44d. Please send dashboard invite.
Ava (CS): Created ticket CS-9330 to track enablement, dashboard access, renewal note. Enablement call 2026-04-11 15:00 PT. Tag #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Rina (Network): Confirmed BGP advert and route filters. Monitoring alert for path flaps added.
Tom (Eng-Infra): Will update thread when job starts and when pilot ends with numbers.
Ava (CS): Closing loop for now.
